test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 26 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following sentences is correct if an object is in uniform motion?

options.text: The object moves with varying speeds.
The object moves with a constant speed.
The object does not travel equal distances with respect to equal time intervals.
The object travels with different acceleration.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 2: The object moves with a constant speed.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• An object in uniform motion travels equal distances in equal intervals of time, indicating a constant speed.
 
• Uniform motion implies that the velocity of the object does not change over time.
 
• In uniform motion, both the magnitude and direction of the object's velocity remain constant.
